notes: New: Simulator: six new arrows (Rift the teleporter, Automaton the robot, Aeon the sentient god, Chrono, Crimson and Prism), each with its own power, ultimate, trail and sound; Simulator: two new stages, Circuit (a living neon circuit board) and Cosmos (a glass deck over deep space). Improved: Simulator Coliseum: arrows move slower and smoother, take wide curving runs at each other and stick with a target longer
